_comment: Hand-maintained registry: chapter_id -> {chapter_master_id (required), path (required, chapter folder relative to data/), publication_id?, estimated_time?}. Keys starting with _ are ignored. PROVISIONAL FILE: no GSEB row has been fetched yet, so every chapter_master_id, publication_id and path here is null — those ids exist only in the education DB and are never invented; an upload carrying a guessed id lands clean under the wrong chapter. chapter_id follows gseb_eng_gujarati{grade}_ch{N} (VERIFY-1: the medium slot is the medium of instruction, NOT the subject language, and must be confirmed against the live server before the first upload). Rows cover the numbered chapters of the five GSEB Gujarati (dvitiya bhasha) readers in ../Textbooks-pdf/std-6 .. std-10; front matter, the revision blocks, the vyakaran units and the purak-vachan pieces carry no chapter number and get a row only if the board assigns one.
_verify_2: Fill each row from the DB, not by arithmetic: (1) chapter_master_id per chapter — the neighbouring Hindi pack's 355-N style formulas do NOT transfer; (2) publication_id — the GSEB publication row; (3) path — V2/{board}/{publication}/{medium}/class_{N}/gujarati/ch_{n}, whose board/publication/medium segments are read off an existing row or a post-upload readback (a precedent row reads V2/bseap/cbse/telugu/class_7/science/ch_2, so the segments genuinely vary). Update reference/naming_conventions.md and profiles/boards/gseb_gujarati.md in the same pass.
